heroFilms.note: Edited with ffmpeg. Each film is 720x1280: the clip is cropped to 720x1000 and placed at the top, with a blurred, darkened copy filling the space below so a phone screen is filled without cropping the cars. Segments crossfade (0.5 s) and fade at the loop point.
